chars.SON: SON: a thin young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.DAD: DAD: a middle-aged man wearing a brown wool djellaba with the hood down and a white knitted taqiya cap
chars.FQIH: FQIH: an old man with a white turban and a cream djellaba, holding green prayer beads
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a young man in a red tracksuit with white stripes and a black cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the doorway of a small modest Moroccan bedroom: DAD stands mid-gesture pointing at SON with wide alarmed eyes, mouth open as if declaring something shocking, SON sits on the edge of the bed looking up confused and tired. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, light comic expression. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A narrow alley in old Sidi Kacem: DAD walks fast pulling SON by the wrist, SON drags his feet reluctantly, rolling his eyes. Medium shot, faces visible. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small room with floor cushions and a low wooden table with an old book and incense: FQIH sits cross-legged welcoming, SON sits opposite with arms crossed, sceptical raised eyebrow. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: FQIH places one hand over SON's head and reads with closed eyes, SON kneels with eyes open looking sideways awkwardly. Warm lamp light, smoke of incense. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: SON leans forward with a desperate pleading face, hands open, FQIH listens fingering his prayer beads. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: FQIH leans back laughing kindly and shaking his head in surprise, SON smiles awkwardly despite himself. Cosy room with cushions. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Outside the fqih's green wooden door in the alley, SON walks out shrugging with empty hands, DAD waits looking hopeful and worried. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening street in a small Moroccan town with shops and street lamps: SON walks very fast alone, hood up, hands in pockets, staring ahead, passers-by turning to look. Full body, face visible. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SON sits on a low wall at dusk in a Moroccan neighbourhood talking, FRIEND sits beside him listening with a hand on his shoulder, concerned. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, no letters, no writing anywhere.
